title: Claimed lint hardening + three bite-tests did not land: lint_demo_network.py keeps the 35-line cross-arm window and a synthetic unguarded payment_api call still passes it (exit 0, reproduced)
evidence:
if arm_name in EXEMPT_ARMS or arm_name in DEMO_INTERCEPTED:
            continue
        ...
        window = "\n".join(lines[max(0, idx - 35) : idx])
        guarded = "model.demo_mode" in window or "updated_model.demo_mode" in window
        if not guarded:
            violations.append(...)  // and DEMO_INTERECTED is still prose-synced only: '# Messages whose real arms in update_inner are unreachable in demo mode because demo/demo_update.gleam intercepts them ... Keep this in sync with the request messages in demo_update.handle'. Reproduction: injected arm 'UserClickedSyntheticR3BiteCheck(id) -> { let eff = payment_api.create_checkout_session(id, "tok", fn(_) { AppNoOp }) ...' directly below UserToggledNotificationDropdown's demo_mode guard; `python3 scripts/lint_demo_network.py` printed 'demo no-network lint clean' and exited 0 (mutation reverted after).
detail: The r3 bar required depth-aware arm boundaries, a mechanical DEMO_INTERCEPTED cross-check, and three bite-tests (unguarded arm / cross-arm guard / manifest drift). None exist: grep finds no bite-test anywhere, the window still bleeds across arms (reproduced), and the manifest is hand-synced prose. The P0 no-network pin remains vacuous-pass-capable.
recommended_fix: Scope the guard window to the enclosing arm, cross-check DEMO_INTERCEPTED against demo_update.handle mechanically, and add the three synthetic-violation bite-tests to CI.

title: Dispatch-level store-threading pin covers only create/publish/edit/bulk-reject; the close/archive/restore/status-change/refcheck/notification-mark demo arms thread demo_store identically but reverting their `demo_store: Some(next)` stays green
evidence: UserConfirmedCloseVacancy(id) -> ... let #(next, eff) = demo_api.close_vacancy(store, id, "", ApiReturnedCloseVacancy) ... Model(..model, demo_store: Some(next), confirm_action: None, loading_action: Some(LoadingClose))  // meanwhile client/test/demo/demo_flow_test.gleam contains exactly these mutation pins: demo_create_vacancy_mutates_store_test, demo_publish_vacancy_mutates_store_test, demo_edit_vacancy_mutates_store_test, demo_bulk_reject_mutates_store_test (grep 'pub fn demo_' over client/test/demo/ — no close/archive/restore/status/refcheck/notification dispatch test exists)
detail: The B2-class regression (a dispatch arm discarding the mutated store) is pinned for 4 of ~10 store-threading arms. I mutation-verified the publish pin bites (revert -> 601 passed, 1 failure), but the identical pattern in close/archive/restore/demo_status/fire_demo_refcheck/mark-notification arms has no test that would fail.
recommended_fix: Add one dispatch-level store-mutation test per remaining threading arm (close, archive, restore, status change, refcheck action, mark-read).

title: Exit-hygiene pin is partial: demo_exit_clears_demo_data_test asserts only 5 of the 15 fields clear_demo_state resets — reverting the notifications/comparison/archived/awaiting/application_detail clears keeps all 602 tests green
evidence:
via_logout.vacancies |> should.equal(NotAsked)
  via_logout.dashboard_stats |> should.equal(NotAsked)
  via_logout.vacancy_detail |> should.equal(NotAsked)
  via_logout.leaderboard |> should.equal(NotAsked)
  via_logout.demo_mode |> should.be_false  ...  via_nav.vacancies |> should.equal(NotAsked)  // vs clear_demo_state which also clears: comparison_details: NotAsked, archived_vacancies: NotAsked, awaiting_list: NotAsked, notifications: NotAsked, unread_count: 0, application_detail: NotAsked
detail: Mutation-verified both ways: dropping `vacancies: NotAsked` from clear_demo_state fails the test (601 passed, 1 failure — good), but no test populates-then-asserts notifications/comparison_details/archived_vacancies/awaiting_list/application_detail after either exit, so those clears are unpinned. The nav exit is pinned only for vacancies.
recommended_fix: Populate every demo-touched field before exit and assert all of them NotAsked on both the logout and public-route-nav exits.

title: Demo refcheck actions — including the r2-fixed substitute path that now applies the typed referee trio — have zero test coverage at store or dispatch level
detail: Six refcheck actions (start/skip/re_enable/take_over/correct/substitute) plus the hyphenated wire-name mapping in fire_demo_refcheck are unpinned; a revert of the substitute fix (blanking the typed contacts) fails no test.
recommended_fix: Add store-level tests for each apply_refcheck branch and one dispatch-level test for UserSavedRefcheckEdit with RefcheckEditSubstitute asserting the typed contact lands.

title: Multi-month date rollover (roll_forward) fixed in source but unpinned — tests exercise only the 21-day single-rollover path
detail: The r2 #14 fix (invalid closes_at like 2026-09-33) landed as a recursive roll_forward, but no test drives validity_days >= ~43, so a revert to single-rollover stays green.
recommended_fix: Add a boundary test creating a vacancy with validity_days 45+ asserting a valid closes_at date.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
detail: P0 behavior ~100% pinned and two pins mutation-verified (publish `let _ = next` revert -> fail; clear_demo_state vacancies revert -> fail; 602 client tests green at baseline) BUT the P0 no-network structural pin is unsound (cross-arm bleed reproduced, bite-tests absent). P1 ~55-65%: of ~12 mutation/secondary-surface behaviors only create/edit/publish/bulk-reject + store-level archive/restore/set_status are pinned; close/mark_opened/refcheck/status-dispatch threading unpinned. Overall ~65-70% < 80%.
recommended_fix: Land the hardened lint + three bite-tests, extend the dispatch pins to all store-threading arms, assert all 15 cleared fields on both demo exits, and cover refcheck/mark_opened/date-boundary paths — that lifts P1 past 90% and the gate to PASS.
